name: WhaleBeing
tagline: Predicts blue-whale habitat day by day and shows where shipping routes cross it, to cut ship strikes.

awards: First Place: Nintendo Switch + Nord Securities Bundle

problem: Ships kill many whales each year, though slowing down or rerouting costs operators little; the team cites a global figure.
solution: A habitat-suitability model based on a published 2019 study predicts daily blue-whale presence off California; a web app overlays real shipping routes to flag high-risk crossings.
demo_moment: Team-described: pick a date and see where routes intersect predicted whale habitat.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “First Place: Nintendo Switch + Nord Securities Bundle” and “Dyson Innovation Challenge” among 134 submissions.
Built on a cited, peer-reviewed habitat model.
Won first place and an innovation challenge with a narrow, well-evidenced problem.

lessons: Standing on a published model makes a weekend prediction credible.
